We asked NFL players for their go-to pregame songs 🎧🏈

From Jahmyr Gibbs choosing Nick Jonas’ “Jealous” to Rashee Rice going with Meek Mill’s “Dreams and Nightmares,” their answers covered everything from Drake and Lil Durk to gospel music from Tasha Cobbs Leonard.

Chase Brown — “Charged Up” by Drake
Isaiah Rodgers — Tasha Cobbs Leonard
Mike Ford Jr. — “Back Again”
Khalil Dorsey — “MVP” by BASHFORTHEWORLD
